Ab_Roller: Kneel and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Roll forward, extending your body as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull back with your abs. Start with short ranges.
Alternating_Renegade_Row: Get into a push-up position with your hands on two kettlebells and your feet slightly apart.
Row one kettlebell towards your hip without rotating your body and lower it.
Repeat with the other hand, keeping your hips still.
Atlas_Stone_Trainer: Stand with the stone (or trainer) between your feet and wrap your arms under it.
Lift it to your thighs, rest it there for a moment and extend your hips to bring it to your chest.
Set it on the platform or lower it with control. A strongman exercise: learn it under supervision.
Atlas_Stones: Stand over the stone with your feet either side and wrap your forearms under it.
Lift it to your thighs, re-grip and extend your hips forcefully to load it onto the platform.
A very demanding strongman exercise: start with light stones and supervision.
Axle_Deadlift: Set up as for a deadlift in front of a thick bar (axle).
Grab it with both hands overhand, with a straight back.
Stand up by pushing the floor away. The thickness of the bar works your grip a lot.
Backward_Drag: Hook up the sled ropes and hold them with your arms straight, facing the sled.
Walk backwards with short steps and your knees bent, dragging the sled.
Balance_Board: Step onto the balance board with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your balance without the edges touching the floor, knees slightly bent.
Hold for the set time. Have something nearby to hold on to.
Barbell_Ab_Rollout_-_On_Knees: Kneel with a loaded barbell in front of you, gripped shoulder-width apart.
Roll the bar forward, extending your body without letting your lower back sag.
Barbell_Squat_To_A_Bench: Place a bench behind you and the bar on your upper back.
Lower by pushing your hips back until you brush the bench, without sitting all the way down.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Bear_Crawl_Sled_Drags: Attach the sled to a harness or belt and get on all fours with your knees lifted.
Crawl forward (opposite hand and foot together), dragging the sled.
Keep your back flat and your hips low.
Bench_Press_with_Chains: Hang chains from the ends of the bar.
Do a normal bench press: the load increases as you press up.
Ask someone to help you unrack and rack the bar.
Bench_Sprint: Stand in front of a low bench with one foot on top.
Alternate your feet on the bench as fast as you can, as if running.
Bent_Press: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Without pressing it, lean your torso to the opposite side and forwards until your arm is straight beneath it.
Stand up keeping your arm vertical. Advanced exercise: learn it with a light weight.
Bodyweight_Mid_Row: Hold a door frame, post or straps at chest height and lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your body towards your grip, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Box_Skip: Stand in front of a low box.
Jump one foot onto the box while driving the opposite knee up, like a skip.
Box_Squat_with_Bands: Hook bands from the bottom of the rack to the bar and place a box behind you.
Lower until you sit gently on the box.
Drive up hard: the resistance increases as you stand.
Box_Squat_with_Chains: Hang chains from the bar and place a box behind you.
Lower until you sit gently on the box.
Drive up hard: the load increases as you stand.
Car_Deadlift: Stand inside the car frame (or trainer) with the handles at your sides.
Grab them with a straight back and stand up by pushing the floor away.
Lower with control. A strongman exercise.
Chain_Press: Lie on the bench with chains hanging from a light bar.
Do a bench press: the load increases as you press up.
Chest_Push_from_3_point_stance: Get into a sprinter's start position with one hand on the floor and the medicine ball in the other, by your chest.
Explode out and throw the ball forcefully forwards with both hands.
Chest_Push_with_Run_Release: Hold the medicine ball at chest height.
Throw it forcefully forwards and sprint after it.
Circus_Bell: Hold the thick-handled dumbbell (circus bell) with one hand and help with the other.
Bring it to your shoulder with a leg and hip drive.
Press it overhead with one arm. A strongman exercise.
Clean_and_Jerk: Do a clean: lift the bar from the floor to your shoulders, catching it in a front squat.
Stand up, dip your knees slightly and drive the bar overhead, dropping under it (the jerk).
Stabilise with your arms straight. Very technical: learn it with a coach.
Conans_Wheel: Get under the wheel's arm, hugging it at chest height.
Walk in a circle, driving with your legs, with a straight back.
A strongman exercise: complete the set number of laps.
Crucifix: Stand holding a weight in each hand with your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Hold the position as long as you can without lowering your arms.
Deadlift_with_Bands: Hook bands from the base of the rack to the ends of the bar.
Do a normal deadlift: the resistance increases as you stand up.
Deadlift_with_Chains: Hang chains from the ends of the bar.
Do a normal deadlift: the load increases as you stand up.
Depth_Jump_Leap: Step off to the floor and, as soon as you land, jump up and forward as far as you can.
Land softly. Start with a low height.
Donkey_Calf_Raises: Lean your torso forward with your hands on a support and the balls of your feet on a step.
With load on your hips (machine or partner), rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Double_Kettlebell_Snatch: Place two kettlebells between your feet and grab them with a straight back.
With a hip drive, bring them up in one movement until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them with control. Advanced exercise.
Exercise_Ball_Crunch: Lie with your lower back on an exercise ball and your feet on the floor.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Return with control, stretching over the ball.
Exercise_Ball_Pull-In: Get into a push-up position with your shins on an exercise ball.
Bring your knees towards your chest, rolling the ball.
Straighten your legs again with control.
Forward_Drag_with_Press: Hook up the sled ropes and hold them at chest height, with your back to the sled.
Take a step and press your hands forward, straightening your arms.
Bring them back and repeat as you move forward.
Front_Barbell_Squat_To_A_Bench: Place a bench behind you and the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Lower with an upright torso until you brush the bench.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Front_Plate_Raise: Stand holding a plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it in front with straight arms to eye level.
Gironda_Sternum_Chins: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull while leaning back so that your chest, at the level of the breastbone, reaches the bar.
Hang_Snatch: Stand with the bar in your hands and a very wide grip.
Lower it to just above your knees and extend your hips and legs explosively.
Catch it with your arms straight overhead in a squat. Learn it with a coach.
Hang_Snatch_-_Below_Knees: Stand with the bar in your hands and a very wide grip.
Lower it to just below your knees and extend explosively.
Catch it overhead in a squat. Learn it with a coach.
Hanging_Pike: Hang from a bar with your arms straight.
Raise your straight legs until your feet near the bar, bending at the hips.
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions: Get on the hyperextension bench with your hips at the edge of the pad and your ankles secured.
Lower your torso by bending at the hips with a straight back.
Come up until your torso is in line with your legs, without over-arching.
Inverted_Row_with_Straps: Grab the suspension straps and lean back with your body straight and your heels on the floor.
Pull your body towards your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control. The more horizontal, the harder it is.
Keg_Load: Stand next to the keg and wrap your arms under it.
Lift it to your hips or chest with a leg drive.
Load it onto the platform. A strongman exercise.
Kettlebell_Pistol_Squat: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in front of your chest and stretch the other leg out in front.
Squat down on the standing leg as far as you can control.
Stand up by pushing through that leg. Advanced exercise.
Kipping_Muscle_Up: Hang from the bar and create a controlled swing with your body.
Use the momentum to pull and bring your chest over the bar.
Press until your arms are straight at the top. Very advanced.
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars: Support yourself on the parallel bars with your arms straight and your body hanging.
Raise your knees towards your chest by bending at the hips.
Kneeling_Arm_Drill: Move your arms as when running, elbows at 90 degrees and hands travelling from hip to face.
Keep the rhythm for the set time.
Kneeling_Jump_Squat: Kneel with a light bar on your upper back.
Jump explosively from your knees to land on your feet in a squat.
Stand up and kneel down again. Advanced exercise.
Linear_3-Part_Start_Technique: Get into a starting position with one foot forward and your torso leaning.
Explode out by pushing hard with your front leg and driving your arms.
Take short, powerful first steps, gradually straightening up.
Log_Lift: Set the log on the floor and grab it by the handles.
Lift it, rolling it up your thighs to your chest.
Press it overhead with help from your legs. A strongman exercise.
Lying_Bent_Leg_Groin: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Let your knees fall out to the sides until you feel the stretch in your groin.
Lying_Face_Down_Plate_Neck_Resistance: Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end and a light plate held on the back of your head over a towel.
Raise your head backwards with control.
Lower slowly. Use very little weight.
Lying_Face_Up_Plate_Neck_Resistance: Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end and a light plate on your forehead over a towel.
Bring your chin towards your chest with control.
Lower slowly. Use very little weight.
Mixed_Grip_Chin: Hang from the bar with one hand overhand and the other underhand.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower with control and switch grips on the next set.
Muscle_Up: Hang from the bar or rings with a firm grip.
Pull hard towards your chest and, at the top, bring your shoulders over your grip.
Press until your arms are straight. Very advanced.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Snatch: Place the kettlebell between your feet and grab it with one hand.
With a hip drive, bring it up in one movement until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower it with control and repeat. Switch hands.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Split_Snatch: With the kettlebell between your feet, grab it with one hand.
Bring it overhead in one movement while splitting your legs.
Bring your feet together with your arm straight and lower it with control.
One-Arm_Medicine_Ball_Slam: Hold the medicine ball in one hand overhead.
Slam it forcefully into the floor beside you.
Pick it up and repeat. Switch arms.
One-Arm_Overhead_Kettlebell_Squats: Press a kettlebell overhead with your arm straight.
Squat down keeping your arm vertical.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. Switch arms.
One-Arm_Side_Deadlift: Stand next to a barbell, parallel to your feet, and grab it in the middle with one hand.
With a straight back, stand up.
Lower with control and switch sides.
One_Arm_Chin-Up: Hang from the bar with one hand, underhand.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower with control. A very advanced exercise.
One_Half_Locust: Lie face down with your arms by your sides.
Lift one straight leg off the floor without rotating your hips.
Hold for a few seconds and switch legs.
One_Leg_Barbell_Squat: With the bar on your upper back, rest the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
Lower by bending your front leg.
Stand up by pushing through it. Switch sides.
Open_Palm_Kettlebell_Clean: Hold the kettlebell by the handle, hanging between your legs.
Bring it up with a hip drive and catch it with an open palm under the bell at chest height.
Practise with a light weight and space around you.
Otis-Up: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a plate held on your chest.
Sit up and, at the top, press the plate overhead.
Bring it back to your chest and lie down again with control.
Overhead_Squat: Hold the bar overhead with a very wide grip and your arms straight.
Squat down keeping the bar over the middle of your feet.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. It demands a lot of mobility: start with a stick.
Parallel_Bar_Dip: Support yourself on the parallel bars with your arms straight.
Lower by bending your elbows until they are at about 90 degrees.
Push until your arms are straight.
Physioball_Hip_Bridge: Rest your upper back on an exercise ball with your feet on the floor.
Raise your hips until your body is aligned, squeezing your glutes.
Plate_Pinch: Pinch two smooth plates together with your fingers, smooth sides facing out.
Hold as long as you can with your arm straight at your side.
Plate_Twist: Sit with your knees bent and lean your torso back, holding a plate.
Rotate your torso, taking the plate to one side and then the other.
Plyo_Kettlebell_Pushups: Get into a push-up position with one hand on a kettlebell.
Do an explosive push-up and switch the hand on the kettlebell in the air.
Land with your elbows slightly bent and repeat.
Power_Jerk: With the bar on the front of your shoulders, bend your knees slightly.
Drive up and push the bar overhead, catching it in a half squat with your arms straight.
Stand up. Learn it with a coach.
Power_Snatch: Set up as for a snatch, with a very wide grip.
Extend explosively and catch the bar overhead in a half squat.
Stand up. Learn it with a coach.
Press_Sit-Up: Lie on a decline bench with a light bar on your chest.
Sit up while pressing the bar overhead.
Lower back down with the bar to your chest.
Push-Ups_With_Feet_On_An_Exercise_Ball: Get into a push-up position with your shins or feet on an exercise ball.
Lower your chest towards the floor with your body straight.
Push until your arms are straight without letting the ball move.
Push_Press: With the bar on the front of your shoulders, bend your knees slightly.
Straighten your legs forcefully and use the momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lower it with control to your shoulders.
Reverse_Band_Deadlift: Hang bands from the top of the rack and hook them to the bar; they will help you at the bottom.
Finish standing and lower with control.
Reverse_Band_Power_Squat: Hang bands from the top of the rack and hook them to the bar.
Do the squat: the bands help you at the bottom.
Reverse_Band_Sumo_Deadlift: Hang bands from the top of the rack and hook them to the bar.
Do the sumo deadlift: the bands help you at the bottom.
Finish standing and lower with control.
Reverse_Plate_Curls: Stand holding a plate by the edges with your palms facing down.
Curl it up with your elbows at your sides.
Rickshaw_Carry: Stand inside the frame (rickshaw) and grab the handles.
Lift it with a straight back and walk with short steps.
Cover the set distance. A strongman exercise.
Rickshaw_Deadlift: Stand inside the frame and grab the handles.
Stand up by pushing the floor away with a straight back.
Ring_Dips: Support yourself on the rings with your arms straight and your elbows tucked.
Lower by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping the rings from drifting apart.
Push until your arms are straight. Harder than on parallel bars.
Rocky_Pull-Ups_Pulldowns: Hang from the bar with a wide grip.
Do one pull-up bringing the bar to your chest and the next bringing it behind your neck, only if it is comfortable for your shoulders.
Rope_Climb: Grab the rope above your head and grip it with your feet as well.
Climb by alternating your hands while your feet lock the rope.
Come down with control, without dropping.
Sandbag_Load: Stand over the sandbag and wrap your arms under it.
Lift it to your hips or chest with a leg drive.
Load it onto the platform or your shoulder.
Seated_Band_Hamstring_Curl: Sit with a band anchored in front of you and looped around your ankles.
Bend your knees, pulling your heels back against the band.
Seated_Head_Harness_Neck_Resistance: Sit with the neck harness on and a light weight hanging from it.
Raise your head back from having your chin on your chest.
Lower with control. Very little weight.
Side_Hop-Sprint: Hop sideways over a cone or obstacle several times.
On the last hop, sprint forwards.
Side_To_Side_Chins: Hang from the bar with a wide grip.
Pull, bringing your chin towards one hand and, on the next rep, towards the other.
Single-Cone_Sprint_Drill: Place a cone a few metres away.
Sprint to it, go round it and come back to the start.
Repeat at full speed with controlled changes of direction.
Single-Leg_High_Box_Squat: Stand on a high box with one foot and let the other hang off the side.
Squat down on the standing leg.
Stand up by pushing through it. Switch legs.
Single-Leg_Hop_Progression: Take small hops forward on that leg, landing softly.
Gradually increase the distance and switch legs.
Single_Leg_Push-off: Stand with one foot on a low box.
Push off that leg to jump up.
Land in the same position and repeat. Switch legs.
Sled_Drag_-_Harness: Attach the sled to a harness at your waist or shoulders.
Walk or run forwards, leaning your body and driving with your legs.
Sled_Overhead_Backward_Walk: Facing the sled, hold the ropes overhead with your arms straight.
Walk backwards dragging the sled without lowering your arms.
Sled_Overhead_Triceps_Extension: With your back to the sled, hold the ropes behind your head with your elbows bent.
Straighten your arms forward and take a step.
Bend your elbows again and repeat as you move forward.
Sled_Push: Hold the sled poles with your arms straight and your body leaning.
Push it walking or running with powerful strides.
Sled_Reverse_Flye: Facing the sled, hold the ropes with your arms straight out in front.
Open your arms out to the sides, dragging the sled, and take a step back.
Sled_Row: Facing the sled, hold the ropes with your arms straight.
Row them towards your stomach, driving your elbows back, and take a step back.
Snatch_from_Blocks: Set the bar on blocks at knee height with a very wide grip.
Extend explosively and catch the bar overhead in a squat.
Stand up. Learn it with a coach.
Speed_Squats: Rest a light bar on your upper back.
Lower into the squat with control and stand up as fast as you can.
Few reps per set, aiming for speed.
Split_Snatch: Set up as for a snatch.
Extend explosively and catch the bar overhead while splitting your legs.
Bring your feet together with the bar overhead. Learn it with a coach.
Squat_Jerk: With the bar on the front of your shoulders, bend your knees slightly.
Drive up and catch the bar overhead in a deep squat.
Stand up with your arms straight. Learn it with a coach.
Standing_Olympic_Plate_Hand_Squeeze: Stand holding an Olympic plate by the rim with one hand, pinching it.
Hold as long as you can with your arm straight at your side.
Suspended_Fallout: Hold the suspension strap handles with your arms straight and your body leaning forward.
Let your body fall forward, taking your arms overhead, with your body straight.
Suspended_Push-Up: Grab the suspension strap handles with your body leaning forward and straight.
Lower your chest between your hands by bending your elbows.
Push until your arms are straight.
Suspended_Reverse_Crunch: Put your feet in the suspension straps and get into a push-up position.
Bring your knees towards your chest.
Straighten your legs again with control.
Suspended_Row: Grab the suspension strap handles and lean back with your body straight.
Pull your body towards your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Suspended_Split_Squat: Rest the top of one foot in the suspension strap behind you.
Lower by bending your front leg.
Stand up by pushing through it. Switch sides.
Svend_Press: Stand squeezing two plates together between your palms at chest height.
Straighten your arms out in front while keeping the squeeze.
Return to your chest with control.
Tire_Flip: Crouch in front of the tyre and get your fingers under the edge, chest against it.
Drive with your legs and hips to lift it and, as it rises, push it with your hands until it flips over.
A strongman exercise: keep your back straight and have supervision.
Trap_Bar_Deadlift: Stand inside the hex bar with the handles at your sides.
Grab them with a straight back and stand up by pushing the floor away.
Lower with control. It is usually easier on the back than the barbell deadlift.
Weighted_Ball_Hyperextension: Lie face down on an exercise ball with your feet against a wall and a plate held to your chest.
Raise your torso until it is in line with your legs.
Weighted_Ball_Side_Bend: Lie on your side on an exercise ball with your feet against a wall.
Raise your torso towards the ceiling by contracting your side.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Weighted_Bench_Dip: Place your hands on a bench behind you and your feet on another, with a plate on your thighs.
Lower by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push until your arms are straight.
Weighted_Crunches: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a medicine ball held on your chest.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs.
Weighted_Pull_Ups: Hang a weight from a belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Weighted_Sit-Ups_-_With_Bands: Lie down with a band anchored behind you and hold its ends by your chest.
Sit up against the band's resistance.
Weighted_Squat: Stand on two platforms with a weight hanging from a belt between your legs.
Squat down with your torso upright.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Wrist_Roller: Stand holding the roller with your arms straight out in front and the weight hanging from the rope.
Turn the roller with your wrists to wind up the rope and raise the weight.
Unwind it slowly to lower it.
Yoke_Walk: Get under the yoke with the bar on your upper back.
Lift it by straightening your legs and walk with short, quick steps.
Cover the set distance. A strongman exercise.
Zercher_Squats: Hold the bar in the crook of your elbows, close to your body.
Squat down with your torso upright.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Iron_Crosses_stretch: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Swing one straight leg across your body towards the opposite hand, without lifting your shoulders.
Come back and alternate sides with control.
Upper_Back-Leg_Grab: Sit with your legs together and your knees slightly bent.
Grab behind your knees and round your back, pulling backwards.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your upper back.
Side_Wrist_Pull: Standing, raise one arm overhead and hold that wrist with the other hand.
Pull gently to the opposite side, leaning your torso.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and switch sides.
Platform_Hamstring_Slides: Lie on your back with your heels on a slider or a towel on a smooth floor.
Raise your hips and slide your heels towards your glutes.
Straighten your legs again with control.
Moving_Claw_Series: Swing the other leg forwards and back in a clawing motion, pawing the ground backwards.
Repeat and switch legs. It is a running-technique drill.
Wind_Sprints: Lie on your back with your legs raised and your knees bent.
Alternate your legs quickly as if pedalling or running in the air.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
